title: Spex Package Config
description: Optional config (spex.package.yaml) at the root of a package. Lets the package own the pre-existing error baseline and the coverage waivers that concern it. spex merges it into the entry of this package in spex.yaml, so it applies to this package only. An empty file is valid and merges nothing.

check_ignore.description: Baseline of pre-existing `error`-severity findings to suppress for this package, merged with the `check_ignore` of this package's entry in `spex.yaml`. Files are relative to this package's root.

coverage_ignore.description: Coverage requirements this package waives for specs, merged with the `coverage_ignore` of this package's entry in `spex.yaml`. Each entry is a spec's `coverage_ignore` entry plus the `spec_id` it applies to.
